selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline topology discovery (node2=lan-a, node3=lan-b, node1 between them)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed node1's vtnet1/vtnet2 are the unassigned lan-a/lan-b uplinks bridged to node2's and node3's second NIC respectively, distinct from the shared management network.

selected_evidence.requirement: OPNsense default-deny baseline before any change
selected_evidence.summary: config.xml showed no opt1/opt2 interfaces defined yet and pfctl showed a catch-all block-all rule for any unassigned interface traffic.

selected_evidence.requirement: Interface assignment for lan-a (opt1) and lan-b (opt2) on node1
selected_evidence.summary: config.xml mutated to add opt1=vtnet1=10.60.1.1/24 and opt2=vtnet2=10.60.2.1/24, then `configctl interface reconfigure` applied them; ifconfig confirms both interfaces are up with the intended IPs and descriptions LANA/LANB.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 addressed on lan-a/lan-b with correct routing to the peer subnet
selected_evidence.summary: nmcli persistent profiles set static IPs 10.60.1.2/24 (node2) and 10.60.2.2/24 (node3) plus explicit static routes to the peer /24 via node1, without creating a conflicting default route.

selected_evidence.requirement: Exactly one path opened: node2 -> node3 TCP/8080, all else still refused
selected_evidence.summary: Single pf pass rule for opt1->10.60.2.2:8080/tcp added and confirmed live in pfctl; firewalld on node3 opened for 8080; functional test shows node2->node3:8080 succeeds (HTTP 200) while ping (both directions) and node2->node3:9090 and node3->node2:8080 all fail, proving only the required flow is open.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime=16:53:37 captured; `shutdown -r now` acked; exec timed out mid-reboot then returned with kern.boottime=16:59:44 (changed); opt1/opt2 IPs, pf pass rule, and ip forwarding confirmed restored; end-to-end curl to node3:8080 from node2 succeeded post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=03408ac4... captured; `systemctl reboot` acked; exec timed out then returned with boot_id=7dbfca00... (changed); static route to 10.60.2.0/24 and TCP/8080 reachability to node3 confirmed restored.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=6ab6a71b... and firewalld port 8080/tcp captured; `systemctl reboot` acked; exec timed out then returned with boot_id=c38d5dd9... (changed); static route to 10.60.1.0/24 and firewalld 8080/tcp confirmed restored, and full end-to-end retest (8080 works, ping/9090 refused) confirmed the required single path survived all three restarts.
